text: 金十数据9月15日讯，锦富技术公告，公司全资子公司上海金锦富已在上海金山区设立项目实施主体金山金锦富，推进“新材料东部生产基地项目”。金山金锦富拟购买46666.93平方米工业用地使用权，挂牌起始价7842万元，并拟与上海碳谷绿湾产业园管理委员会签订产业合作协议。该项目计划总投资约10.14亿元，其中固定资产投资总额不低于7.61亿元，主要建设无氟胶黏剂、电子粘结剂、热管理冷却液等产能。项目资金拟通过自有、自筹资金及银行项目贷款等方式解决。
text_en: Jinshi Data, September 15 — Jinfu Technology announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary Shanghai Jinjinfu has established an project implementation entity, Jinshan Jinjinfu, in Jinshan District, Shanghai, to advance the 'New Materials Eastern Production Base Project.' Jinshan Jinjinfu plans to purchase the right to use 46,666.93 square meters of industrial land, with a starting listing price of 78.42 million yuan, and plans to sign an industrial cooperation agreement with the Shanghai Carbon Valley Green Bay Industrial Park Management Committee. The project has a planned total investment of approximately 1.014 billion yuan, of which total fixed asset investment shall be no less than 761 million yuan, mainly to build production capacity for fluorine-free adhesives, electronic bonding agents, thermal management coolants, etc. Project funding is planned to be resolved through own funds, self-raised funds and bank project loans.
